title: Map zoom + landscape scaling, center-on-town, event-log snap-to-top
detail: Wheel + +/-/reset zoom were dead (canvas became a flex item floored at its min-content backing width); fixed with flex-shrink:0. Map now contain-fits the landscape board (W+H) and re-fits on resize; view starts zoomed/centered on the colony. Event log snaps to top on a new item. UI ticket — owes a screenshot.

timeline.note: Shipped in PR #43; verified in headless Chromium + 56 smoke checks.
